changelog:
Initial release of seo-article-review skill.

- Provides an SEO/AEO diagnostic assistant for content creators, marketers, and technical teams.
- Outputs article summary, diagnostic conclusions, actionable suggestions, and reusable deliverables based on user inputs.
- Accepts goals, audience details, material links or files, and various SEO/AEO related parameters.
- Supports quick, standard, or in-depth review modes and multiple input formats.
- Delivers prioritized recommendations and next steps for article optimization and AI citation readiness.
